# M0-S5 I3: cgo="restricted" governs dependency packages, not just the
# main module. The allowlist names one dependency module glob; the
# allowlisted loGo/s dependency builds, the other loGo/s dependency fails,
# and a Go dependency with cgo fails too.
# SPEC 10.3: 'With "restricted", each package that imports C MUST match
# cgo_allowlist.' That sentence names every package with no Go-module
# exception, so the Go dependency must fail as well.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Default CC: a host compiler setting must not drive the build.
env CC=

# Clear any host CGO_ENABLED so the restricted key alone decides.
env CGO_ENABLED=

cd m

# The allowlisted dependency builds through the main module, end to end.
[cgo] logos build -o main.bin .
[cgo] exec ./main.bin
[cgo] stdout '^good: 42$'

# The allowlisted dependency also builds when named directly.
[cgo] logos build example.com/cgood/p

# The non-allowlisted loGo/s dependency fails with the pinned error.
[cgo] ! logos build example.com/cbad/q
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] package example\.com/cbad/q uses cgo and is not in cgo_allowlist'

# SPEC 10.3 "each package that imports C": the Go dependency fails too.
[cgo] ! logos build example.com/cgodep/r
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] package example\.com/cgodep/r uses cgo and is not in cgo_allowlist'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/cbad v0.0.0
	example.com/cgood v0.0.0
	example.com/cgodep v0.0.0
)

replace (
	example.com/cbad v0.0.0 => ../cbad
	example.com/cgood v0.0.0 => ../cgood
	example.com/cgodep v0.0.0 => ../cgodep
)

-- m/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "restricted"
cgo_allowlist = ["example.com/cgood/**"]

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cgood/p"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("good:", p.Answer())
}

-- cgood/go.mod --
module example.com/cgood

go 1.27

-- cgood/p/p.lgo --
package p

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

// Answer reports the C helper result.
func Answer() int {
	return int(C.answer())
}

-- cbad/go.mod --
module example.com/cbad

go 1.27

-- cbad/q/q.lgo --
package q

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

// Answer reports the C helper result.
func Answer() int {
	return int(C.answer())
}

-- cgodep/go.mod --
module example.com/cgodep

go 1.27

-- cgodep/r/r.go --
package r

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

// Answer reports the C helper result.
func Answer() int {
	return int(C.answer())
}
